name: ProSearchTable 检索表格
description: 带检索栏与分页的表格封装：fetch 逻辑进 composable，列定义进 hooks，检索栏/工具条拆子组件——目录化入库 7 个文件，demo.vue 可在线预览。

files.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Table } from 'ant-design-vue'
import { useProTable } from './useProTable'
import { useColumns } from './hooks/useColumns'
import FilterBar from './components/FilterBar.vue'
import Toolbar from './components/Toolbar.vue'
import type { SearchTableProps } from './types'

const props = defineProps<SearchTableProps>()

// 检索/分页/loading 全部收进 composable，组件零业务状态
const { loading, dataSource, pagination, run, search } = useProTable(props.fetch, {
  defaultPage: 1,
  pageSize: 20,
})
const columns = useColumns(props.rowActions)
</script>

<template>
  <section class="pro-search-table">
    <FilterBar :search="search" :loading="loading">
      <slot name="filter" />
    </FilterBar>
    <Toolbar>
      <slot name="toolbar" />
    </Toolbar>
    <Table
      :loading="loading"
      :columns="columns"
      :data-source="dataSource"
      :pagination="pagination"
      row-key="id"
      @change="run"
    />
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// 示例文件：预览入口。沙箱里没有 unplugin 自动注册，antd 组件显式导入 + PascalCase
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Input } from 'ant-design-vue'
import ProSearchTable from './index.vue'

const kw = ref('')

// 预览环境没有真实后端：fetch 用本地模拟数据
const ALERTS = [
  { id: 1, time: '14:03:11', src: '10.1.1.5', type: 'LNK 泛洪' },
  { id: 2, time: '14:02:47', src: '172.16.8.23', type: 'SSH 暴力破解' },
]
const fetch = (q) => Promise.resolve({
  items: ALERTS.filter((r) => !q.kw || r.src.includes(q.kw)),
  total: ALERTS.length,
})
</script>

<template>
  <ProSearchTable :fetch="fetch" :row-actions="['研判']">
    <template #filter>
      <Input v-model:value="kw" placeholder="按源 IP 检索" allow-clear />
    </template>
  </ProSearchTable>
</template>

name: extractAlertFields 告警字段提取
description: 从 syslog / CEF 原文里提取 src、dst、端口、等级等关键字段，返回结构化对象；值班时快速取字段不用肉眼扫日志。右侧预览可直接粘贴日志实测。

name: useDebounceFn
description: 通用防抖 composable：立即执行首调用，尾部触发合并；表格检索、窗口 resize 场景直接贴走。

name: Result 统一返回包装
description: Spring Boot 统一响应体：code / message / data 三段式，静态工厂 ok / fail 直出；配合全局异常处理器使用。Java 资产暂不支持在线预览。

name: grep 应急速查
description: 凌晨处置时 3 秒翻出来的 grep 组合拳：按场景索引，从百万行日志里圈人、圈 IP、圈时间窗。

files.code:
# grep 应急速查

## 圈出某 IP 的全部行为（含上下文）
```bash
grep -C 3 '10.1.1.5' /var/log/secure
```

## 时间窗内的高频源 IP TOP20
```bash
grep '02/Sep/2026:14:' access.log | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
```

## 只看失败登录（暴破研判）
```bash
grep -i 'failed password' /var/log/secure | grep -v 'invalid user'
```
